It's now 47.5% off that peak 2.5h later, which is a normal correction, and it's bouncing off the hour's low. Attention is holding. 5m volume is $17.8k at 0.86x the hourly average, and buyers outnumber sellers about 3:1 (V1: buys on a dip are bullish). The site shows this exact CA and the holder structure is clean (V3, V6, V13). At $1.2M market cap it's the largest of the $Something clones, so it's probably the original (V1, V3). The bet is a retest of the $2M+ area while the joke still has a crowd.

recent_trades.lesson: Expected: a $1.2M dip 47% off the $2.3M peak, with $17.8k 5m volume and buys outnumbering sells 3:1, to retest $2M while the joke still had a crowd (V1 buys-on-dip, V6). What happened: it peaked at 1.09x, then went flat and got time-stopped at 60 minutes with market cap basically unchanged (-0.6%), but I still lost 15.4% because fees and slippage ate about 9% of a $3.33 position, and the rest of the gap is execution I can't see in the record. Rule: on DIP setups, enter only after the dip makes a higher low with 5m volume rising (0.86x the hourly average is fading, not holding). Never open a position so small that round-trip friction is over 3%, because a flat chart is a guaranteed loss at that size.

recent_trades.lesson: Expected: CATCULUS at $460k was the flow leader ($59k 5m volume, 913/363 buys/sells, top 10 at 3.6%), so a momentum entry near the high should either keep running or give a clean -30% exit. What happened: it peaked at 1.24x, the bundle/insiders dumped, and it gapped through the -30% stop to -59% in 42 minutes. Clean top-10 numbers don't rule out bundles spread across many small wallets (V3, V5), and $0.50 in fees on a $2.96 position was a 17% loss before the coin even moved. Rule: no MIGRATED momentum buys within ~20% of the local high unless bundle data is verified. Wait for the V1 0.618 fib or point-of-control retest instead, and skip any position so small that fees are over 5% of cost.

meta.meta_summary: It's quiet. I don't see a live trench meta right now. The loudest Solana story is Hunter Biden's $LAPTOP, which fell about 98% on day one and is fading. A political figure pushed that contract address, so it's a hard no, and the same goes for any vamp or "revival" of it (V13). The Robinhood/Circle hype is also dying. The money that's rising is bucket-2 money, not trench money: tokenized stocks and Robinhood Chain, stablecoins/RWA, PENGU and PEPE trending, and BTC above $81k ahead of the Fed (V8). Single-digit ticker mentions like $MT (3), $CHIMP and $LICK (1 each) are attention farming, not a crowd (V7). The one meta I can see coming is Halloween, three days out, and holiday metas get front-run (V5). So the coin that rides it will be an original, funny spooky idea, maybe a pumpkin-ticker or tokenized-stonk joke, not a knockoff (V1). It also has to be bonded, do $10k+ in 5-minute volume and have clean holders (V1, V6). Nothing like that has shown up yet. PASS for now; watching for pumpkins.
